name: Central Service Map
description: Aggregated service boundaries across all modelled journeys. Each entry captures the service's owned entities, published events, consumed events, synchronous API endpoints, and the journeys that contributed data. As additional journeys are modelled, new owned_entities and events are merged into each service entry and the source_journeys array is extended. Architectural principle: a service owns its entities exclusively — no shared databases between services.

services.name: Mortgage Service
services.description: Owns the end-to-end residential mortgage application lifecycle (JRN-006). Promoted sub-capability of CAP-001. Same-capability peer to SVC-001 — may call SVC-001 directly. Communicates with SVC-012 (Risk Engine, CAP-004) and SVC-014 (KYC/AML, CAP-005) exclusively via async events through SVC-102.

consumed_events.name: CreditCheckCompleted
consumed_events.purpose: JRN-006: Receives credit check result (soft at DIP, hard at full application) from SVC-012. If DIP soft check passes: issues DIP (EVT-021). If full application hard check passes: stores result for underwriter review.

consumed_events.name: KYCClearanceGranted
consumed_events.purpose: JRN-006: Confirms existing customer KYC is current. Allows mortgage application to proceed without new CDD. Reuses existing KYC result from JRN-001 pattern.

consumed_events.name: KYCReferralRaised
consumed_events.purpose: JRN-006: New customer KYC referred for EDD. Mortgage application suspended pending KYC resolution.

consumed_events.name: SanctionsHitDetected
consumed_events.purpose: JRN-006: Sanctions match detected on customer or property AML check. Application immediately blocked.

consumed_apis.purpose: GET /customers/{id} to fetch Customer identity data for ESIS and offer document generation. No local copy of Customer fields in SVC-002.
Dispatch all customer notifications: DIP issued, application received, valuation updates, underwriting decision, mortgage offer, completion confirmation, welcome pack.
Instructs property valuations directly via surveyor panel management system.

consumed_apis.call_pattern: Synchronous — CHAPS payment instruction on completion day
consumed_apis.purpose: Releases mortgage funds to solicitor on completion day. Irrevocable same-day RTGS settlement.

new_consumed_events.name: MortgageCompletionPaymentConfirmed
new_consumed_events.purpose: JRN-028 PH-082: Transitions MortgageAccount (ENT-016) status to 'completed'. Sets completion_date. Triggers completion documentation dispatch. Idempotent on mortgage_account_id + chaps_execution_id.

jrn028_additions.note: JRN-028 completes the JRN-006 mortgage lifecycle. SVC-002 now consumes EVT-112 from SVC-009 (CAP-003) to close the mortgage. Cross-capability CAP-003 → CAP-001 event.

consumed_events.name: DirectorVerified
consumed_events.purpose: SVC-005 updates DirectorRecord.verification_status and UltimateBeneficialOwner.verification_status. Tracks completeness of all required individual verifications before BPH-005 CDD assessment can proceed.

consumed_events.name: BusinessKYCCleared
consumed_events.purpose: Gates BPH-006 account decision. SVC-005 will not run the decision engine without BusinessKYCCleared (MLR 2017 Regulation 28 compliance gate).

consumed_events.name: BusinessKYCReferralRaised
consumed_events.purpose: Transitions BusinessApplicationRecord.status to 'referred'. Suspends account decisioning pending MLRO/EDD resolution.

consumed_events.name: BusinessSanctionsHitDetected
consumed_events.purpose: Immediately blocks the application. Transitions status to 'blocked'. No further processing until MLRO resolution.

consumed_apis.call_pattern: Synchronous (blocking at BPH-002); async retry on timeout
consumed_apis.purpose: SVC-005 calls the CH API to verify company identity (MLR 2017 Regulation 28(11)), retrieve officer list (directors), and PSC list (UBO starting point). Sole caller — CH data is distributed to other services via domain events.
Business portal authentication from BPH-008 onwards. PSR 2017 SCA compliance.

jrn013_additions.note: JRN-013 adds SVC-006 (Trade Finance Service) as a promoted sub-capability peer within CAP-002. SVC-005 is called synchronously by SVC-006 for facility headroom checks (GET /business-accounts/{id}) and settlement account debits (POST /business-accounts/{id}/debit). SVC-005 also consumes EVT-075 (LCApplicationSubmitted) and EVT-082 (LCExpired) from SVC-006 to maintain BusinessCustomer.active_lc_count and release facility headroom respectively.

new_consumed_events.name: LCApplicationSubmitted
new_consumed_events.purpose: JRN-013 PH-052: SVC-005 updates BusinessCustomer.active_lc_count on new LC application. Triggers preliminary facility pre-check.

new_consumed_events.name: LCExpired
new_consumed_events.purpose: JRN-013 EXC-002: SVC-005 releases the lc_amount from blocked facility headroom and decrements BusinessCustomer.active_lc_count when an LC expires without a drawing.

new_api_endpoints: POST /business-accounts/{id}/debit — called by SVC-006 (same-capability) for LC settlement account debit in PH-058

new_owned_entities: ENT-017 (LoanApplication) — aggregate root for the SME term loan origination workflow
ENT-019 (FacilityAgreement) — executed facility agreement with covenants and conditions precedent
ENT-020 (LoanAccount) — active loan ledger account tracking outstanding balance and repayment schedule
ENT-021 (CovenantMonitoring) — immutable per-test covenant compliance records

new_consumed_events.name: CreditAssessmentCompleted
new_consumed_events.purpose: JRN-007 PH-018: Receives automated IRB scoring (PD, LGD, EAD, ECL, risk_rating) from SVC-012. Stores assessment_id reference on LoanApplication. Routes to Credit Analyst queue. Triggers mandatory committee referral if risk_rating >= 8.

jrn007_additions.note: Business Lending (CAP-002.02) is a RETAINED sub-capability within SVC-005 — no separate business lending microservice. SVC-005 instructs SVC-009 (Domestic Payments, CAP-003) synchronously for CHAPS drawdown disbursement. SVC-005 communicates with SVC-012 (Risk Engine, CAP-004) exclusively via async events (EVT-032/EVT-033) — no synchronous calls cross the CAP-002/CAP-004 boundary.

services.name: Credit Card Service
services.capability_domain: CAP-001 (Retail Banking — Credit Cards sub-capability, promoted)
services.description: Owns the end-to-end credit card application and account lifecycle (JRN-008). Promoted sub-capability of CAP-001. Same-capability peer to SVC-001 — may call SVC-001 directly. Communicates with SVC-012 (Risk Engine, CAP-004) exclusively via async events through SVC-102. PCI DSS v4.0 scoped: card_number_token used exclusively; raw PAN handled only via card processing platform PCI CDE.

consumed_events.name: CreditCheckCompleted
consumed_events.purpose: JRN-008 PH-024: Receives hard credit check result (outcome, credit_risk_band, recommended_credit_limit, credit_assessment_reference) from SVC-012. Transitions ENT-022 status to 'assessment_complete'. Triggers PH-025 decisioning workflow. Idempotent on application_id + check_type.

consumed_apis.purpose: GET /customers/{id} to fetch Customer identity data for credit bureau submission and card issuance. No local copy of Customer fields in SVC-003.

jrn005_additions.new_published_event: EVT-094 (ReimbursementCredited) — published after SVC-001 credits the reimbursement amount to the customer Account on consumption of FraudReimbursementApproved (EVT-092). Contains credited_amount, transaction_id, and sla_business_days_elapsed (PSR SLA compliance evidence).
jrn005_additions.new_consumed_event: EVT-092 (FraudReimbursementApproved from SVC-013) — triggers reimbursement credit execution. SVC-001 credits FraudCase.reimbursement_amount to the customer Account. Idempotent on case_id.

consumed_events.name: KYCClearanceGranted
consumed_events.purpose: Gates account provisioning. SVC-001 will not create an Account record without receiving this event. Triggers transition of ApplicationRecord.current_phase to PH-005.

consumed_events.name: KYCReferralRaised
consumed_events.purpose: Transitions ApplicationRecord.status to 'referred' and current_phase to AP-001. Account provisioning is suspended pending manual EDD completion.

consumed_events.name: SanctionsHitDetected
consumed_events.purpose: Immediately blocks account provisioning; transitions ApplicationRecord.status to blocked.

consumed_events.name: DigitalChannelActivated
consumed_events.purpose: Confirms the account is operationally accessible to the customer; updates any account-level digital access flag.

consumed_events.name: CustomerRiskScoreUpdated
consumed_events.purpose: Adjusts account-level monitoring thresholds in SVC-001 to reflect an updated KYC risk tier. Non-blocking post-onboarding event.

consumed_events.name: SARFiled
consumed_events.purpose: SVC-001 reads the restriction_required flag. If true, applies enhanced_monitoring_flag to all accounts belonging to customer_id. SVC-001 receives ONLY the minimal payload (sar_id, customer_id, restriction_required, filed_at) — no NCA reference, no SAR narrative. Tipping-off prohibition (POCA 2002 s333A) strictly enforced: account restriction notices to customer use pre-approved generic language only.

consumed_events.name: SARConsentRequested
consumed_events.purpose: SVC-001 places the specific transaction (consent_transaction_ref) on hold pending NCA consent. Fail-closed design: transaction hold persists in the absence of a positive SARConsentGranted signal.

consumed_events.name: SARConsentGranted
consumed_events.purpose: SVC-001 releases the transaction hold for consent_transaction_ref. This is the ONLY signal that may release the hold.

consumed_events.name: FraudReimbursementApproved
consumed_events.purpose: JRN-005: Triggers reimbursement credit execution. SVC-001 credits FraudCase.reimbursement_amount to Account identified by account_id in event payload. Debits APP fraud loss suspense account. Publishes ReimbursementCredited (EVT-094). Idempotent on case_id — duplicate events for the same case_id do not result in duplicate credits.

consumed_events.name: CreditCardIssued
consumed_events.purpose: JRN-008 PH-026: SVC-001 updates the customer's product holdings record to include the new CreditCardAccount (ENT-023.account_id). Enables Single Customer View completeness and cross-sell eligibility. Intra-capability event (CAP-001). Idempotent on account_id.

consumed_apis.purpose: SVC-001 calls SVC-050 to initiate identity verification and retrieve KYCClearanceGranted or KYCReferralRaised result before creating an Account record.
SVC-001 consumes the CustomerRiskScoreUpdated event from SVC-014 to adjust account-level monitoring thresholds post-onboarding.
SVC-001 calls SVC-100 for customer authentication in online and mobile banking sessions from PH-006 onwards.

jrn002_consumed_events.name: SanctionsScreeningCompleted
jrn002_consumed_events.purpose: Evaluates sanctions outcome for PaymentIntent. If clear and EVT-P03 also clear: publishes PaymentCleared. If hit: publishes PaymentFailed with reason = sanctions_review and alerts MLRO.

jrn002_consumed_events.name: FraudScoreCompleted
jrn002_consumed_events.purpose: Evaluates fraud risk level. If block: publishes PaymentFraudBlocked. If non-block and EVT-P02 also clear: publishes PaymentCleared.

jrn002_consumed_events.name: PaymentExecuted
jrn002_consumed_events.purpose: Triggers account ledger debit by payment amount. Updates PaymentIntent.status = completed. Updates Account.daily_payment_total. Publishes AccountDebited.

new_published_events.name: ClientAccountSummaryProvided
new_published_events.trigger: JRN-015 ALT-002: SVC-001 receives EVT-101 (ClientAccountDataRequested) from SVC-016. Assembles minimal account summary (available_balance_gbp, account_type, snapshot_at). Publishes EVT-107 as the async response. Minimal payload — full account history excluded. Correlated via request_id.

new_consumed_events.name: ClientAccountDataRequested
new_consumed_events.purpose: JRN-015 ALT-002: SVC-001 receives the cross-capability account data request from SVC-016. Looks up Account (ENT-004) for the client_id, filters to requested account types, assembles minimal summary. Publishes EVT-107 (ClientAccountSummaryProvided). Idempotent on request_id.

jrn015_additions.note: JRN-015 extends SVC-001 with a new async request-response pattern for cross-capability account data access. EVT-101 → EVT-107 pair is the approved mechanism for CAP-006 to access CAP-001 account data. No new owned entities.

new_published_events: DirectDebitInsufficientFunds — published when D-0 balance check fails for a Direct Debit collection (EVT-074-triggered flow)
AccountCredited (DD indemnity variant) — published after crediting customer account under DD Guarantee

new_consumed_events.name: DirectDebitInstructionCreated
new_consumed_events.purpose: Records new DDI against account for account management display. Informational — does not gate any account operation.

new_consumed_events.name: DirectDebitInstructionValidated
new_consumed_events.purpose: Updates account management state — DDI now active and visible in customer dashboard.

new_consumed_events.name: DirectDebitCollectionSubmitted
new_consumed_events.purpose: Surfaces upcoming Direct Debit collection in customer's upcoming transactions view at D-2.

new_consumed_events.name: DirectDebitIndemnityClaimFiled
new_consumed_events.purpose: CRITICAL: triggers immediate account credit under DD Guarantee. Must process within 30 seconds. Idempotent on claim_id. Consumer group for payments.direct-debit topic must be configured as high-priority low-latency.

jrn012_additions.consumer_group_nfr: SVC-001's consumer group for topic payments.direct-debit is configured as high-priority with < 30-second processing SLA to meet the DD Guarantee immediate credit obligation on EVT-074.

new_consumed_events: EVT-P02 (SanctionsScreeningCompleted) — already consumed for JRN-002; extended to handle OB-initiated payments via origination_channel = open_banking flag on PaymentIntent. Clear + EVT-P03 non-block: publish PaymentCleared and subsequently EVT-062 on completion. Hit: publish EVT-P07 and EVT-063.
EVT-P03 (FraudScoreCompleted) — already consumed for JRN-002; extended to handle OB-initiated payments. Non-block + EVT-P02 clear: publish EVT-P04. Block: publish EVT-P08 and EVT-063.
EVT-P05 (PaymentExecuted) — already consumed for JRN-002; on completion of OB-initiated payment, additionally publishes EVT-062 (OpenBankingPaymentCompleted).
jrn010_additions.new_api_consumed: SVC-100 token introspection — SVC-001 calls SVC-100 to validate TPP access tokens on each POST /payments call for OB-initiated payments.
jrn010_additions.entity_extension: ENT-008 (PaymentIntent) extended with three new fields: consent_id (FK to ENT-030), origination_channel (enum: direct | open_banking), tpp_id (FK to ENT-031). See data-model.json entity_extensions.

new_consumed_events: EVT-029 (MortgageCompleted from SVC-002) — updates Customer product holdings to reflect completed mortgage
EVT-030 (MortgageAccountOpened from SVC-002) — updates Single Customer View for FSCS purposes
jrn006_additions.note: SVC-001 does not own any new entities for JRN-006. Customer (ENT-001) and Account (ENT-004) data is read by SVC-002 directly via same-capability API call.

new_owned_entities: ENT-053 (CHAPSPaymentIntent) — CHAPS-specific payment intent with CoP result, SCA reference, purpose code, and mortgage completion linkage

new_consumed_events.name: CHAPSPaymentSettled
new_consumed_events.purpose: JRN-028 PH-081→PH-082: Debits Account (ENT-004). Updates Account.chaps_daily_total. Transitions ENT-053 to completed. Idempotent on chaps_execution_id.

new_consumed_events.name: CHAPSPaymentFailed
new_consumed_events.purpose: JRN-028 EXC-003/EXC-004: Releases reserved funds. Transitions ENT-053 to failed.

jrn028_additions.entity_extension: ENT-004 (Account) extended with chaps_daily_total field — sum of CHAPS payments settled from this account on the current UTC calendar day. Separate from daily_payment_total (FPS).
jrn028_additions.note: JRN-028 adds CHAPS payment initiation and authorisation to SVC-001. ENT-053 (CHAPSPaymentIntent) is a new entity separate from ENT-008 (PaymentIntent/FPS) due to different state machine and mandatory ISO 20022 fields.

jrn004_additions.new_owned_entity: ENT-B005 (BusinessKycAssessment) — company-level KYC/CDD record for legal entity customers, extending the KycAssessment pattern (ENT-003) for commercial-specific requirements
jrn004_additions.new_capabilities: Fan-out sanctions screening for company + multiple directors/UBOs in parallel; sector risk assessment; jurisdictional risk scoring; EDD trigger determination for legal entities; pKYC monitoring activation on BusinessAccountProvisioned

consumed_events.name: IdentityVerificationCompleted
consumed_events.purpose: JRN-001: Signals personal identity verification complete (outcome = pass). SVC-014 uses payload as PEP/sanctions/adverse media screening inputs.

consumed_events.name: CompaniesHouseVerified
consumed_events.purpose: JRN-004: Company details (legal name, SIC codes, incorporation date) as CDD inputs for company-level screening.

consumed_events.name: UBOIdentified
consumed_events.purpose: JRN-004: UBO details — registers individual in the BPH-005 screening queue.

consumed_events.name: DirectorVerified
consumed_events.purpose: JRN-004: Verified identity data (name, DOB, nationality) for each director/UBO — triggers individual PEP/sanctions/adverse media screening.

consumed_events.name: BusinessAccountProvisioned
consumed_events.purpose: JRN-004: Activates pKYC ongoing monitoring for the BusinessCustomer entity.

consumed_apis.call_pattern: Synchronous (blocking per entity — parallel fan-out for JRN-004 business applications)
consumed_apis.purpose: SVC-014 calls SVC-051 for sanctions screening. Hard limit: 3,000ms (GOV-005-R02). JRN-004: fan-out to screen company + each director + each UBO in parallel.
SVC-014 subscribes to identity verification completion events to obtain verified identity data as CDD inputs.

SVC-014 submits SARs to the NCA UKFIU via SAR Online API. Retry policy: 3 attempts with exponential backoff (1s, 2s, 4s). Fallback: MLRO manual submission via NCA web portal with manual nca_reference entry.

new_consumed_events.name: SuitabilityReportIssued
new_consumed_events.purpose: JRN-015 PH-074: SVC-014 creates a lightweight SuitabilityRecord in the CAP-005 compliance store. Maps: assessment_id, review_id, client_id, advisor_fca_register_ref, review_type, risk_profile_score, issued_at → SuitabilityRecord fields.

new_consumed_events.name: ConsumerDutyEvidenceCompleted
new_consumed_events.purpose: JRN-015 PH-076: SVC-014 creates a ConsumerDutyComplianceRecord. If remediation_required=true, raises compliance alert on Head of Compliance dashboard.

jrn015_additions.note: JRN-015 adds two new cross-capability consumed events to SVC-014 for MiFID II suitability compliance registration and Consumer Duty fair value monitoring. No new owned entities — the compliance records are internal data structures within CAP-005.

new_consumed_events: EVT-020 (MortgageEnquiryStarted from SVC-002) — checks if customer KYC is current; publishes KYCClearanceGranted if existing customer with valid KYC
EVT-022 (CreditCheckRequested, check_reason: full_application) — triggers AML source-of-funds check on property purchase
jrn006_additions.note: SVC-014 reuses existing EVT-004 (KYCClearanceGranted), EVT-005 (KYCReferralRaised), EVT-006 (SanctionsHitDetected) for JRN-006 — no new published events required.

consumed_events.name: SARInvestigationOpened
consumed_events.purpose: SVC-015 receives this event to create an MLRO case management alert and add the investigation to the MLRO dashboard.

consumed_events.name: SARDecisionMade
consumed_events.purpose: SVC-015 updates the MLRO dashboard with decision status and SLA countdown timer.

consumed_apis.call_pattern: Synchronous (blocking) — all entity reads and writes
consumed_apis.purpose: SVC-015 is the MLRO UI/orchestration layer. It delegates all SAR and investigation entity persistence to SVC-014. SVC-015 holds no SAR state independently.

consumed_events.name: ApplicationStarted
consumed_events.purpose: SVC-017 uses this event to initialise the application flow UI and display the provisional application reference to PER-001.

consumed_events.name: IdentityVerificationCompleted
consumed_events.purpose: SVC-017 advances the application wizard from PH-002 to PH-003 holding screen on receipt of this event (outcome = pass).

consumed_events.name: KYCClearanceGranted
consumed_events.purpose: SVC-017 advances the UI from PH-003 holding screen to PH-004 decision result screen.

consumed_events.name: KYCReferralRaised
consumed_events.purpose: SVC-017 displays the 'additional review required' message to PER-001 with the 3-business-day SLA and case reference.

consumed_events.name: SanctionsHitDetected
consumed_events.purpose: SVC-017 displays the generic decline message to PER-001 without disclosing the sanctions match (tipping-off prohibition).

consumed_events.name: ApplicationDecisionMade
consumed_events.purpose: SVC-017 renders the decision result screen (approval confirmation, referral status, or decline notification with FOS signpost).

consumed_events.name: AccountOpened
consumed_events.purpose: SVC-017 advances the UI to the account details confirmation screen in PH-005.

consumed_events.name: AccountProvisioned
consumed_events.purpose: SVC-017 confirms sort code and account number are live and advances to PH-006 digital channel activation setup.

consumed_events.name: CardIssuanceTriggered
consumed_events.purpose: SVC-017 displays the estimated card delivery date in PH-005/PH-007 and triggers the card dispatch notification via SVC-053.

consumed_apis.purpose: SVC-017 calls SVC-100 to create credentials, register FIDO2/WebAuthn device, and verify SCA authentication on first login.
SVC-017 reads Account data from SVC-001 to render the PH-007 welcome dashboard.
SVC-017 calls SVC-053 to dispatch all customer-facing communications including the welcome pack and FSCS information sheet.

jrn010_additions.channel_classification: SVC-017 is a CHANNEL service (outside the system boundary). It is not a capability in the architectural sense. For JRN-010 it acts as the OBIE-compliant Open Banking API surface, routing consent and payment initiation calls synchronously to SVC-001 (channel → capability call — permitted). It holds no persistent domain state for JRN-010 (ENT-030 and ENT-031 owned by SVC-001).
new_consumed_events: EVT-062 (OpenBankingPaymentCompleted from SVC-001) — updates internal payment status cache to AcceptedSettlementCompleted for TPP polling.
EVT-063 (OpenBankingPaymentFailed from SVC-001) — updates internal payment status cache to Rejected with mapped OBIE error code for TPP polling.
new_consumed_apis: SVC-001: POST /open-banking-consents, PATCH /open-banking-consents/{id}, POST /payments (with consent_id), GET /payments/{id} — synchronous channel → capability calls for consent management and payment initiation.
SVC-100: OAuth 2.0 authorisation server — DCR, consent authorisation redirect, SCA orchestration, token endpoint, token introspection.

jrn004_additions.new_published_event: EVT-B004 (DirectorVerified) — individual identity verification completion event for business customer directors and UBOs. Carries verified identity data (name, DOB, nationality) as CDD inputs for SVC-014 individual screening. One event per individual. Replaces/parallels IdentityVerificationCompleted in the commercial onboarding context.
jrn004_additions.new_capabilities: Multiple concurrent identity verification sessions per business application (up to 10 individuals); secure email invitation dispatch to directors/UBOs who are not the primary applicant; per-individual verification status tracking per business_application_id; context field added to ENT-002 IdentityVerification for commercial use (business_application_id, individual_type, individual_entity_id)

consumed_events.name: ApplicationStarted
consumed_events.purpose: JRN-001: Signals new retail application initiated. SVC-050 initialises the identity verification workflow.

consumed_events.name: ApplicationDecisionMade
consumed_events.purpose: JRN-001: Closes or archives the onboarding case per MLR 2017 Regulation 40.

consumed_events.name: AccountOpened
consumed_events.purpose: JRN-001: Marks the onboarding journey complete; closes the onboarding case.

consumed_events.name: KYCClearanceGranted
consumed_events.purpose: JRN-001: Marks KYC/CDD step complete; closes the identity verification orchestration session.

consumed_events.name: BusinessApplicationStarted
consumed_events.purpose: JRN-004: Initialises the business onboarding case. No verification sessions created yet — created after BPH-003 UBO identification.

consumed_events.name: UBOIdentified
consumed_events.purpose: JRN-004: Creates identity verification session for each UBO and dispatches secure invitation email. Primary applicant session activated immediately in-app.

consumed_apis.purpose: SVC-050 calls SVC-051 for preliminary sanctions pre-check at the start of both retail (JRN-001) and commercial (JRN-004) onboarding workflows.
SVC-050 triggers SVC-014 to initiate CDD assessment via identity verification completion events (IdentityVerificationCompleted for JRN-001; DirectorVerified for JRN-004).

services.name: Sanctions Screening Service
services.owned_entities_note: SVC-051 owns no entities. It is a stateless synchronous screening API. The sanctions_screening_result produced by SVC-051 is persisted within KycAssessment.sanctions_screening_result (owned by SVC-014).

published_events_detail.trigger: SVC-051 receives an updated sanctions list from ComplyAdvantage / Refinitiv World-Check (OFSI, OFAC, UN, EU lists refreshed).
SVC-051 completes a real-time sanctions screen triggered by consuming PaymentIntentCreated (EVT-P01). JRN-002 only.
published_events_detail.payload_summary: screening_result_id, payment_intent_id, customer_id, payee details, outcome (clear | hit | error), lists_screened, screened_at

consumed_events.name: PaymentIntentCreated
consumed_events.purpose: JRN-002: Triggers real-time sanctions screen against payee details. Result published as SanctionsScreeningCompleted.

consumed_events.name: PaymentExecuted
consumed_events.purpose: JRN-002: Writes confirmed FPS execution to OFSI audit log per GOV-005-R02.

consumed_apis.call_pattern: Synchronous write (fire-and-forget after result returned to caller)
consumed_apis.purpose: Every screening decision is immutably logged to SVC-103. OFSI requires an audit log of all sanctions screening decisions.

new_owned_entities: ENT-034 (DirectDebitInstruction) — BACS DDI lifecycle entity introduced by JRN-012
ENT-035 (DirectDebitCollection) — individual BACS collection event entity introduced by JRN-012

new_consumed_events.name: AccountDebited (DD variant)
new_consumed_events.purpose: D-0 collection confirmation: SVC-001 has debited the account. SVC-009 updates ENT-035.status = collected and publishes EVT-072.

new_consumed_events.name: DirectDebitInsufficientFunds
new_consumed_events.purpose: D-0 balance check failure: SVC-009 creates ARUDD return, updates ENT-035.status = returned, publishes EVT-073.

new_consumed_events.name: AccountCredited (DD indemnity)
new_consumed_events.purpose: Confirms indemnity credit processed. SVC-009 initiates BACS indemnity recovery from originator and submits AUDDIS 0C if cancellation requested.

jrn012_additions.bacs_connectivity_added: AUDDIS (0N new instruction, 0C cancellation), BACS collection file processing, ARUDD returns, BACS indemnity claim scheme interactions. Added to existing Form3/Bottomline PTX connectivity layer.

jrn005_additions.new_owned_entity: ENT-045 (ReimbursementClaim) — tracks the 50/50 PSR cost split between sending bank and receiving PSP. Owned by SVC-009 because it is a Pay.UK scheme interaction artefact. SVC-009 submits recovery claims to the receiving PSP via the Pay.UK reimbursement API.

new_consumed_events.name: FraudReimbursementApproved
new_consumed_events.purpose: Triggers ReimbursementClaim creation. SVC-009 reads receiving_sort_code and fps_reference from the event payload. Creates ReimbursementClaim (ENT-045). Submits recovery claim to receiving PSP via Pay.UK reimbursement API. Publishes RecoveryInitiated (EVT-095).

jrn005_additions.pay_uk_reimbursement_integration: Pay.UK APP fraud reimbursement API added to existing Form3/Bottomline PTX scheme connectivity. SVC-009 orchestration layer extended; connectivity vendor handles scheme protocol.

consumed_events.name: PaymentCleared
consumed_events.purpose: Triggers FPS execution. SVC-009 constructs ISO 20022 pacs.008 and submits to Pay.UK/Vocalink. Creates PaymentExecution (ENT-009). On acceptance: publishes PaymentExecuted (EVT-P05). On rejection after retries: publishes PaymentFailed (EVT-P07).

consumed_events.name: FraudReimbursementApproved
consumed_events.purpose: JRN-005: Triggers ReimbursementClaim (ENT-045) creation and Pay.UK recovery claim submission. SVC-009 reads receiving_sort_code and fps_reference from event payload.

fps_connectivity.build_vs_buy: Buy candidate — Form3 or Bottomline PTX managed connectivity layer. SVC-009 is the bank-owned orchestration wrapper.
fps_connectivity.cop_proxy: SVC-009 proxies CoP requests to Pay.UK CoP service. Channel calls SVC-009 — never Pay.UK directly.

cross_service_interaction_summary.description: End-to-end event and API flow across service boundaries. Covers JRN-001 (Personal Current Account Opening), JRN-002 (Faster Payment Initiation), JRN-003 (SAR Filing by MLRO), JRN-005 (APP Fraud Detection and Reimbursement), JRN-006 (Residential Mortgage Application), JRN-009 (International Wire Transfer Corporate), JRN-011 (Card Transaction Authorisation), JRN-013 (Trade Finance Letter of Credit Issuance), JRN-014 (FX Spot Trade Execution Corporate), and JRN-015 (HNW Investment Portfolio Review).

interaction_sequence.description: PER-001 submits application. SVC-017 calls SVC-001 to create Customer (prospect) and ApplicationRecord. SVC-001 publishes ApplicationStarted (EVT-001).

SVC-050 receives ApplicationStarted. Orchestrates identity verification via Onfido/Jumio. Creates IdentityVerification entity. Calls SVC-051 for preliminary sanctions pre-check. Publishes IdentityVerificationCompleted (EVT-002).

SVC-014 subscribes to IdentityVerificationCompleted. Calls SVC-051 for full sanctions screening (blocking, 3,000ms hard limit). Performs PEP and adverse media screening. Creates KycAssessment entity. Publishes KYCClearanceGranted (EVT-004).
SVC-001 subscribes to KYCClearanceGranted. Automated decision engine runs. ApplicationRecord.status transitions to 'approved'. SVC-001 publishes ApplicationDecisionMade (EVT-007).

SVC-001 creates Account entity (sort code/account number allocated). Updates Customer.status to 'active'. Updates FSCS SCV. Creates CardIssuance entity. Publishes AccountOpened (EVT-008), AccountProvisioned (EVT-009), CardIssuanceTriggered (EVT-010).

SVC-017 receives AccountProvisioned. Guides PER-001 through credential creation and biometric SCA enrolment (calls SVC-100). Creates DigitalEnrollment entity. Publishes DigitalChannelActivated (EVT-011).

SVC-017 receives DigitalChannelActivated. Renders welcome dashboard (reads Account from SVC-001). Calls SVC-053 to dispatch welcome pack (email + in-app, FSCS information sheet). Publishes WelcomePackDispatched (EVT-013).

Suspicion trigger received (automated SanctionsHitDetected EVT-006 or manual staff disclosure via SVC-015). SVC-014 creates SARInvestigationRecord (ENT-009). Publishes SARInvestigationOpened (EVT-014). SVC-015 notifies MLRO via secure case management alert. MLRO investigates: reads ENT-001 (Customer) and ENT-003 (KycAssessment) from SVC-014, and transaction history from SVC-001. Evidence items added to SARInvestigationRecord (WORM append-only).

MLRO records filing decision. SVC-014 creates SuspiciousActivityReport (ENT-008). Publishes SARDecisionMade (EVT-015). MLRO completes NCA SAR form, confirms tipping-off review. SVC-014 submits SAR to NCA SAR Online (synchronous with 3-retry backoff). NCA acknowledges with nca_reference. SVC-014 records filed_date, computes sla_status. Publishes SARFiled (EVT-016) — minimal payload only: customer_id + restriction_required flag. SVC-001 consumes SARFiled, applies enhanced_monitoring_flag to customer accounts. SVC-001 publishes AccountRestrictionApplied (EVT-019).

For consent SARs: SVC-014 also publishes SARConsentRequested (EVT-017). SVC-001 places the specific transaction on hold (fail-closed — no release without EVT-018). MLRO monitors NCA consent response out-of-band via SAR Online portal. On NCA consent grant, MLRO records via POST /sars/{id}/consent-response. SVC-014 publishes SARConsentGranted (EVT-018). SVC-001 releases transaction hold. MLRO closes SARInvestigationRecord. Investigation lifecycle complete.

Customer reports APP fraud via mobile app (CH-002). SVC-017 calls SVC-013 POST /fraud-cases. SVC-013 creates FraudCase (ENT-043, status=open). Publishes FraudCaseCreated (EVT-090). SVC-053 dispatches case confirmation to PER-001. Alternatively: SVC-013 auto-creates FraudCase on PaymentFraudBlocked (EVT-P08) consumption with trigger_type=realtime_block.

Fraud Analyst (PER-054) assigned. SVC-013 (CAP-004) publishes FraudDataRequested to Event Bus (SVC-102). SVC-001 (CAP-001) responds async with FraudDataProvided (PaymentIntent: cop_result, fraud_score). SVC-009 (CAP-003) responds async with FraudPaymentExecutionProvided (fps_reference, receiving_sort_code). Cross-capability synchronous calls are prohibited — all CAP-004↔CAP-001 and CAP-004↔CAP-003 data exchange is async via Event Bus. FraudEvidence records (ENT-044) created. FraudCase.status = investigating. Publishes FraudInvestigationStarted (EVT-091). Investigation conducted against PSR PS23/3 eligibility criteria (vulnerability, gross negligence, CoP evidence).

Analyst records decision via POST /fraud-cases/{id}/decision. Senior Manager co-sign required for declines and reimbursements > £25,000. SVC-013 publishes FraudReimbursementApproved (EVT-092) or FraudReimbursementDeclined (EVT-093). SVC-053 dispatches regulated outcome letter within 5 business days of FraudCase.reported_date (PSR PS23/3 GOV-003-R01).

Dual consumption of FraudReimbursementApproved (EVT-092): (1) SVC-001 credits reimbursement_amount to customer Account. Publishes ReimbursementCredited (EVT-094). P99 < 30 minutes. SVC-053 dispatches credit push notification to PER-001. (2) SVC-009 creates ReimbursementClaim (ENT-045): sending_bank_share and receiving_bank_share = reimbursement_amount * 0.5 each. Submits recovery claim to receiving PSP via Pay.UK reimbursement API. Publishes RecoveryInitiated (EVT-095).

Receiving PSP responds to Pay.UK recovery claim. SVC-009 updates ReimbursementClaim.recovery_status. Publishes RecoveryCompleted (EVT-096) on terminal recovery state. Analyst closes FraudCase: SVC-013 publishes FraudCaseClosed (EVT-097) and FraudPatternDetected (EVT-098) — anonymised pattern features fed back to SVC-013 ML model training pipeline to close the detection-investigation feedback loop. SVC-111 archives full case record (7-year WORM retention).

PER-002 submits LC application via trade finance portal. SVC-006 calls SVC-005 GET /business-customers/{id} (same-capability) to validate applicant. SVC-006 creates LetterOfCredit (ENT-036). Publishes EVT-075 (LCApplicationSubmitted). SVC-006 calls SVC-005 GET /business-accounts/{id} (same-capability) for facility headroom check. In-limit: credit_status = facility_confirmed.

SVC-006 publishes EVT-076 (LCComplianceScreeningRequested) to SVC-102 — crosses CAP-002/CAP-005 boundary. SVC-051 screens beneficiary against OFSI, OFAC, UN lists and HS tariff codes against export controls. On all-clear: SVC-051 publishes EVT-077 (LCComplianceCleared). SVC-006 consumes EVT-077 to gate LC issuance. If hit: SVC-051 raises internal compliance alert; MLRO (PER-058) notified; LC blocked; EVT-077 never published.

SVC-006 formats LC terms and publishes EVT-078 (LCIssued) — crosses CAP-002/CAP-003 boundary. SVC-010 consumes EVT-078 and transmits SWIFT MT700 (Issue of Documentary Credit) to advising bank. Applicant receives issuance confirmation via SVC-053.

PER-059 (Trade Finance Operations) registers document presentation via POST /trade-finance/lc-applications/{id}/presentations. SVC-006 creates ENT-038 (TradeDocument). Publishes EVT-079 (DocumentPresented). 5-banking-day UCP 600 examination clock starts. PER-059 examines documents against LC terms within deadline. SVC-006 records ENT-039 (DocumentExamination). Publishes EVT-080 (DocumentExamined, result=compliant).

interaction_sequence.phase: PH-058 — Settlement (same-capability debit + cross-capability SWIFT reimbursement)
interaction_sequence.description: SVC-006 calls SVC-005 POST /business-accounts/{id}/debit (same-capability) — account debit must succeed before SWIFT event published. On debit confirmation: SVC-006 publishes EVT-081 (LCSettled) — crosses CAP-002/CAP-003 boundary. SVC-010 transmits SWIFT MT202 reimbursement to advising/reimbursing bank. LetterOfCredit.status = settled. If no presentation before expiry: SVC-006 publishes EVT-082 (LCExpired); SVC-005 releases facility headroom.
